output.summary: The user described cyclical pelvic pain returning three months after endometriosis surgery and asked whether another operation was needed, while explaining that the combined pill had caused distressing side effects. The assistant discussed non-surgical options, possible pelvic floor contributions, and when repeat surgery may be considered, then suggested requesting the operative note and arranging follow-up to discuss treatment and physiotherapy. The user said the plan was clear, felt less worried about surgery being the only path, and thanked the assistant for taking the concern seriously.
